programs.name: Learn To Skate - Beginner
programs.description: It’s never too early or too late to learn to skate. With a focus on building confidence on the ice, you will learn basic skating skills including balance and posture, forward and backward skating, gliding and stopping.Mandatory Equipment: Skaters must bring (wear) a CSA-approved hockey helmet and hockey or figure skates.

programs.name: Shinny: Older Adult
programs.description: Hockey Skills Adult are instructional programs geared towards skaters who are interested in learning basic hockey skills with a focus on puck handling, skating and game strategies.  Prerequisite: Successful completion of Learn to Skate - Beginner or able to skate one length of the ice surface. Mandatory Equipment: CSA approved hockey helmet with full face cage or full visor, a hockey stick, hockey skates, hockey gloves and a neck guard. Power Skating is a high-energy instructional conditioning program geared toward all type of skaters with a focus on speed, agility and coordination. Prerequisites: Able to execute cross-overs, backwards stop, one foot turn and backwards circle thrusts (skills from Learn to Skate 4). Mandatory Equipment: CSA approved hockey helmet and hockey or figure skates.

programs.name: Nutrition Program
programs.description: Food and fun are the key elements of the Nutrition Program. To start your day off right, you will be served a healthy breakfast inspired by Canada’s Food Guide and then get the chance to participate in a variety of activities with your peers.

programs.name: Ball Hockey: Instructional
programs.description: Instructional sports activities are designed to introduce sport-specific skills while improving fundamental movement with agility, balance and coordination. programs.description: Instructional sports activities are designed to introduce sport-specific skills while improving fundamental movement with agility, balance and coordination. In badminton, a racquet sport that focuses on hand-eye coordination and has you using your racquet to rally for points with a ‘birdie’ you will learn basics like grip, serve and swing, as well as game rules through drills, practice and play.
